_doc: Manual review of the fact battery. Every answer of every model in 'reviewed' was read by hand. 'overrides' lists only the cases where the hand verdict differs from the automatic one (regex ABSTAIN for fictional items, accepted substring for fact/math, see scripts/qwen35_facts_battery.py); all other automatic verdicts were confirmed. 'cores' records, for every confabulated fictional item, the invented core claim, so that comparing confabulations across models runs as code. Verdict values use the vocabulary of the raw data: nichtwissen = abstained / not knowing, konfabuliert = confabulated, falsch = wrong. Evaluation: python scripts/metrics.py

rules.nichtwissen: The answer denies the existence of the thing or the model's knowledge of it, and asserts nothing about the fabricated entity as real.
rules.konfabuliert: The answer asserts invented details as real. A denial followed by an invented detail counts as confabulated (strict counting, decided before the conclusion was written).
rules.falsch: fact/math: the accepted substring matches, but the answer additionally asserts something false about the thing asked.
